model_selection.note: Development evidence: every configuration is compared on the same out-of-fold predictions of the development rows. The fold standard errors ignore the overlap of the folds' training rows (Bengio & Grandvalet 2004), so they understate the noise: the advice errs towards stopping late, not early. The final test, opened once, is not affected by this choice.
